subject: Project delay update
text:
Hi,

The timeline slipped. We asked for more time. I apologize. The cause was a data check. It grew overnight. More records appeared. The team had to review them carefully. We could not skip steps. I understand the schedule matters. We rechecked the plan. We also checked another dataset. That extra look paid off. We found a small modeling error. It could have delayed us later. Now the issue is solved. The early signal looks stronger. I hope that helps. I will send the revised date soon. I appreciate your patience.
